summary.name: Mooziac
summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar player for YouTube, YouTube Music, and local audio, with SponsorBlock, synced lyrics, and trackpad edge volume gestures.
use_cases: Streaming YouTube Music playlists from the menu bar
Watching 4K YouTube videos without a heavy browser
Playing local audio files alongside streaming
summary.what_it_does: Mooziac is a macOS desktop player for YouTube videos, YouTube Music, and local audio, built with AppKit, WebKit, and CoreAudio rather than Chromium or Electron. It lives in the menu bar so the queue can be reached without switching spaces. Video can use 4K hardware decoding through Apple VideoToolbox, and SponsorBlock is available for skipping sponsored segments. Lyrics scroll in sync with tracks via LRCLib and Lyrics.ovh, and Discord Rich Presence shows the current song, artist, artwork, and remaining time. Favorites and listening history are stored in a local SQLite database, and the page states there are no tracking SDKs, ads, or server telemetry.
notable: Native AppKit/WebKit/CoreAudio build instead of Electron or Chromium
Trackpad edge gesture: slide along the far-right 1mm edge to change volume with haptic feedback
Synced lyrics via LRCLib and Lyrics.ovh
Local SQLite storage with no tracking or telemetry
caveats: Mac only; no Windows or Linux version is mentioned
Install requires running xattr -cr on the app bundle, which the page includes as a step
Trackpad gesture is tied to MacBook trackpads
